items.title: Albert "Fernandez" Walters Interview, 1959-01-05
items.q: Him, Red Caillou, Udell, Walter Pelliborn. They used to have regular jam sessions like bands they have now on the piano. I was quite a youngster. I used to go around and listen to them. Try to imitate them.

ctx.x: We used to call him Long-Head Willie. Yeah, Lil Long-Head. He used to play all them house parties. Him, Red Caillou, Udell, Walter Pelliborn. They used to have regular jam sessions like bands they have now on the piano. I was quite a youngster. I used to go around and listen to them. Try to imitate them. Go home and start playing. Try to get what they get on the piano.
Do you still play piano or something?
